content: ग्राह्य {%a.%} [ग्रह् ण्यत्] .²1 To be taken or seized <ab>&c.</ab>, see ग्रह्. .²2 To be understood; इन्द्रियग्राह्यः <ls>Ms. 1. 7</ls>. .²3 Acceptable; सा सेवा या प्रभुहिता ग्राह्या वाक्यविशेषतः <ls>Pt. 1. 46</ls>. .²4 To be received in a hospitable manner. .²5 To be admitted in evidence; स्वभावेनैव यद्ब्रूयुस्तद् ग्राह्यं व्यावहारिकम् <ls>Ms. 8. 78</ls>. .{@-ह्यम्@} .²1 A present. .²2 The object of sensual perception. .{@-ह्यः@} An eclipsed globe (sun or moon).
